reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03's proof trace claims columns are cached during KZG verification (block_verification.rs:1324-1332) before state transition (per_block_processing at L1614-1629), enabling serving of columns for invalid blocks. This is factually incorrect. Code verification shows: (1) verify_kzg_for_rpc_block at L1326 does NOT cache columns—it only verifies and returns them in a MaybeAvailableBlock; (2) Caching occurs via put_pending_executed_block (beacon_chain.rs:3575), which takes AvailabilityPendingExecutedBlock—the 'Executed' suffix indicates state transition has already passed; (3) early_attester_cache.add_head_block (beacon_chain.rs:3940) is called AFTER fork choice registration (L3908-3918), which happens AFTER state transition. Both cache paths (data_availability_checker and early_attester_cache) only store columns for blocks that have successfully passed per_block_processing. Spec reference: Fulu P2P spec SG-009 INV-005 correctly requires state transition validation before serving, and the implementation enforces this at the cache level—no columns are cached for failed blocks.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P Interface SG-009 INV-005: 'Sidecars should not be served for blocks failing beacon-chain state transition' - implementation correctly enforces this by caching only after state transition passes
